intentions.title: Enforce a server-side default-deny capability gate on every Studio LiveView event, independent of UI hiding
intentions.evidence: caps.ex: attach/1 hooks :handle_event on every StudioLive socket; classify/1 buckets events into :none/:read/:write/:admin/:deny with an explicit default-DENY (unclassified => require admin); derive/1 unions membership (Tenancy.Auth.authorize) and freshly-reloaded active access-grants (Access.list_active_grants_for_grantee) so a mid-session grant expiry is denied immediately; admin is never grant-conferred.

intentions.title: Let an embedded Claude Code agent run safely inside Studio as an admin-only chat surface, never exposing host filesystem/exec access to anonymous or public-demo visitors
intentions.evidence: claude_chat.ex enabled?/0 requires admin-only :admin_studio live_session, hard-refuses when public_demo_studio is set, and requires the `claude` binary/opt-out flag; plan-mode default (--permission-mode plan); bypassPermissions is excluded from normalize_mode and only reachable via an armed ceremony (bypass_armed: true) per 'charter D48 fail-closed law'.

intentions.title: Give the chat agent a first-class two-way control channel (interrupt, live mode/model switching, permission-ask bridging, single-writer session takeover across tabs) instead of a fire-and-forget subprocess
intentions.evidence: ClaudeChat.Session GenServer: control_request/control_response dispatch typed by kind (:interrupt/:set_mode/:set_model/:initialize), respond_permission/3 answering CLI can_use_tool asks with echoed updatedInput, adopt_sink/2 single-writer registry via Barkpark.StudioChat.SessionRegistry so two tabs never double-spawn `claude --resume`, bounded stderr-tail capture for honest exit diagnosis (charter D54).

intentions.title: Teach the embedded agent to answer using Barkpark's own PortableDoc block vocabulary (charts, callouts, stats, tables, mermaid) instead of plain markdown/ASCII
intentions.evidence: claude_chat.ex render_appendix/0 system-prompt appendix documents the ```mermaid and ```portabledoc fences and the native block JSON shapes (callout/chart/stats/table/divider), so replies render through the same paper engine as published papers.

intentions.title: Reconstruct the multi-pane Studio desk (nav columns + open editor) purely from a dataset and URL nav-path, so the same tree walk drives every entry point (deep link, drill-down, backlink jump, graph blast-radius)
intentions.evidence: pane_builder.ex build/3 + walk_path/7: reserved 'graph' and 'open' path heads bypass structure lookup for direct doc/graph opens; resolve/4 normalizes stale pre-tiering deep links onto the gated tree or falls back to an ungated Structure.build(gating: :none) tree so a demoted/disabled type's panes 'still open' (#1851 never-unreachable guarantee); one build_editor/6 dispatch table opens papers/sheets/graph/media-explorer/field-form editors identically whether reached via host desk or plugin-contributed list.

intentions.title: Scope every Studio pane read to the tenant workspace/project (and canonicalize plugin-link hrefs) so multi-tenant desks never leak cross-tenant content
intentions.evidence: pane_builder.ex threads `opts[:scope]` ([workspace_id, project_id]) into every Content.list_documents/get_paper/fetch_doc_with_draft call and `opts[:scope_prefix]` into Paths.plugin_link_href/2 so plugin hrefs canonicalize to the /d/ scoped shape at source rather than at render time.

intentions.title: Keep multi-user collaborative presence honest per-tenant and per-dataset, never mixing avatars across workspaces or same-doc-id docs in different datasets
intentions.evidence: presence_state.ex topic/1 keys the PubSub topic by workspace_id (fixing an instance-global tenant-boundary bug, 'tsk-url-p0'); on_doc/3 filters by both doc_id AND dataset so a doc_id colliding across datasets doesn't show false co-presence; pick_color/1 derives a deterministic avatar hue from the shared Unified Aesthetic TokensGen palette.

intentions.title: Expose a real admin-gated shell (tmux console) into the Studio host for operational access, under the same three-control safety posture as the chat agent
intentions.evidence: tmux_console.ex enabled?/0: admin-only :admin_studio live_session, public_demo_studio hard-refuse (not overridable by the flag), per-host BARKPARK_TMUX_CONSOLE=0 opt-out, and a swappable PTY backend module invoked via apply/3 for testability — same trust model documented as ClaudeChat.

intentions.title: Resolve under-determined ('flat') Studio URLs to the correct workspace/project without ever silently teleporting a user to the wrong tenant
intentions.evidence: scope_resolver.ex resolve/2: kills the old 'first slug-ordered membership' teleport by preferring the Referer header's /w/:ws/p/:proj prefix (re-verified via Tenancy.Auth.member?/2, never trusted as auth) before falling back to first-membership; callers must always 302 (never 301) since the target is per-token/per-Referer.

intentions.title: Emit one generated token module (TokensGen) as the single source of Studio-surface color/lifecycle constants so the Unified Aesthetic manifest, not hand-picked hex, drives presence colors, Sheets conditional-format swatches, and lifecycle glyphs
intentions.evidence: tokens_gen.ex header 'Code generated by design/emit.mjs from design/tokens.json. DO NOT EDIT'; presence_state.ex and sheet_grid.ex consume presence_palette/0 and sheet_cf_backgrounds/0 from here rather than inlining hex; design/check.mjs gates the lifecycle mirror against Go + CSS + tokens.
